headline: "If you confuse, you lose."
caption:
"If you confuse, you lose." — Donald Miller

The StoryBrand principle that breaks most content: if people have to work to understand your message, they're gone. Clarity beats clever every single time.

Say one thing. Say it simply. Then say it again.

headline: "Macro patience, micro speed."
caption:
"Macro patience, micro speed." — Gary Vaynerchuk

Most people do the opposite: slow to post, impatient for results.

headline: Make an offer so good people feel stupid saying no.
caption:

The same applies to content. Make the value so obvious, so useful, so worth-the-watch that scrolling past feels like a mistake.

Over-deliver in the first 5 seconds.

Follow @josephborroto for content that's impossible to scroll past.

headline: What MrBeast obsesses over (and you should too).
bullets: Click-through first: if no one taps, nothing else matters
Then watch time: deliver on the promise fast
Re-do your first 5 seconds until they're perfect
footer_note: Same rules apply to your Reels.
caption:
MrBeast's content philosophy, boiled down — and it maps perfectly to short-form:

1. Obsess over the click (thumbnail/hook). If no one taps, nothing else matters.
2. Then obsess over watch time — deliver on the promise immediately.
3. Re-write your first 5 seconds until they communicate everything.

The biggest creator on earth sweats the open. So should you.

Follow @josephborroto for lessons from the best.

#mrbeast #youtube #shortformvideo #retention #contentstrategy #josephborroto
